entities.name: DAAM-family formin
observations: 768-aa query sequence has Drf_GBD (residues 39–238), Drf_FH3 (243–425), and FH2 (641–768) Pfam domains.
Best sequence hits are DAAM1 mouse and human at ~49% identity across nearly the entire query; DAAM2 chicken and human also match strongly.
Protein-query tool reported annotation transfer as insufficient; specific paralog, localization, and processes remain unverified.
